summary: Phase 4 (physician dashboard / target ranges / alerts + patient symptom check-ins) tested on Java backend and React UI. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (after fixing 3 test-script bugs: wrong field name 'latest' vs 'latest_labs', bean-validation errors return 422 by app convention, wrong enum names in teardown). UI: physician login -> /physician dashboard hero stats, attention/today/recent-labs sections; target set via targets-editor -> patient appears in dashboard attention list, /physician/alerts, nav-alerts-count badge; low>high shows Persian error toast; Persian digits accepted; clearing removes target + alert. Patients list search + filter (all/out/none) work, range-badge correct. Patient /patient/symptoms: save disabled until mood chosen, sliders work (RTL, keyboard), save -> update same day (button text switches to update), Jalali date picker change resets form, trend chart renders with >=2 days, toggle chips work; physician detail shows read-only physician-symptom-trend. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on all tested pages. No clinical recommendation text found. One real bug: TargetsEditor race wipes user edits.

minor.issue: Bean-validation failures (bad mood, negative target, bad enum) return 422 with default English message (e.g. 'must match "good|fair|bad|very_bad"') while service checks return 400 with Persian text. Inconsistent status + non-Persian message if shown to the user.
No user delete endpoint, so pytest-created TEST_p4_* patients (2 accounts) could only be set to disabled, not removed.

ui_bugs.issue: Inputs can be edited before GET /targets finishes. When data arrives, the useEffect resets rows and wipes what the user typed. Reproduced: filled low=0.1/high=0.5 right after the editor rendered, and only target_high=0.5 was saved (low lost). The same reset also happens on any background refetch (window focus / invalidateQueries), which drops unsaved edits.
num() turns non-numeric input into NaN, which JSON.stringify sends as null. Typing junk in both fields silently deletes the target instead of showing a validation error.

issues: Short Jalali month is cut off (shows 'آبا' instead of 'آبان'). Use the full month name or the D/M format.
The alerts count badge only shows in the desktop sidebar, not on the mobile bottom-nav alerts item.

action_items: TargetsEditor: disable inputs or show a loader until targets query isSuccess, and only seed rows once (or when not dirty) so refetch does not clobber edits
TargetsEditor: validate numeric input client-side (reject NaN) instead of sending null
Optionally map MethodArgumentNotValidException messages to Persian / unify 400 vs 422
Fix truncated Jalali month in SymptomTrend tick formatter
critical_code_review_comments: Symptoms.jsx default date uses browser-local dayjs() while backend checks Asia/Tehran. A browser ahead of Tehran (e.g. UTC+9 late evening) would default to a 'future' date and get 400. Compute default from Tehran zone.
Symptoms list fetches only the default 180 days; fine for now, but picking an older date in the picker shows an empty form even if an entry exists (edge case).
PhysicianInsightService.patients() runs per-patient queries (latestPerType, upcoming, last appointment): N+1, fine at demo scale.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Symptom entries (2026-10-01/02 via pytest, 2026-11-05/06 via UI) and all targets were deleted. Pytest created TEST_p4_*@demo.thyrocare.app patient users, which were set to disabled (no delete API).
